About our RSS feed

  • Focused on delivering App Store app discount information
  • Whenever an app's price drops or in-app purchases go on sale, we will promptly send you a notification
  • Each app's discount information is presented in a separate feed
  • The RSS feed is completely open-source, allowing you to view, contribute, and add your favorite apps at any time

Application Description

We live in the world of apps and at times it can be difficult to find the ones we look for… AppRaven helps to discover the best apps and games designed just for you! Connect with people who share the same interests and recommend your favourite games to each other. Make a wish list to never miss a sale and save money on the apps you like the most! AppRaven’s unique features: Discover New Apps • Check daily updated charts to get an overview of the most popular apps around you. • Browse collections of apps created by other users and create your own. • Sort apps by the categories that interest you the most. • Watch your favourite sellers and get notified whenever they have a new release. • Be the first to see newly released apps and the latest updates. Save Money • Check daily which apps are on sale to save time and money. • Add games to your wish list directly from within the App Store using the share extension and get notified whenever they are on sale or updated. • Track apps to see the history of price changes and updates. • Get many paid games for free every day. Join the Community • Find people who love the same apps as you and share them together. • Connect with friends and give recommendations to each other. • Rate and comment on apps and sellers - your opinions matter. • Reply to other users and give them an advice. For your best experience, AppRaven is free and contains no ads!
